units.source_text: 我以往的人生中，羞恥無數。

en.t: My life has been filled with countless shames.

units.source_text: 對我來說，人類的生活無從捉摸。

en.t: To me, human life is impossible to grasp.

units.source_text: 因為我出生在東北鄉村，長大後才第一次看到火車。

en.t: Because I was born in a village in Tohoku, I did not see a train for the first time until I was older.

units.source_text: 我在火車站的天橋上爬上爬下，

en.t: I climbed up and down the footbridge at the train station,

units.source_text: 完全沒有察覺到它是為了橫跨鐵軌而建造的，

en.t: completely unaware that it had been built so people could cross over the tracks,

units.source_text: 只是覺得站內複雜而又有趣的構造，像國外的遊樂場一樣

en.t: thinking only that the station's complex and amusing structure, like a foreign amusement park,
was there for the sake of being fashionable.

units.source_text: 很長一段時間我都這麼想。

en.t: For a very long time, I thought that was what it was.

units.source_text: 沿著天橋上上下下，對我而言是頗為時尚的遊戲，

en.t: Going up and down the footbridge was, to me, a rather stylish game,

units.source_text: 也算是鐵路公司提供的服務裡最令人滿意的。

en.t: and I considered it the most satisfying service the railway company provided.

units.source_text: 後來，當我發現那不過是為了方便乘客橫跨鐵路建造的實用性樓梯時，

en.t: Later, when I discovered it was merely a practical staircase built to let passengers cross the tracks,
